label: organizational subsidiary or unit of
definition: Organization 1 is or was a subsidiary, division, owned organization or unit of parent 2.
scope_notes: Child-to-parent direction; partial or historical ownership and institutional units qualify. Geographic sites, employment and reverse parent-to-child relations do not automatically qualify.

facts.reason: The entity mixes Keller and James, but every row is an editor/critic/speaking role at The Times rather than an organizational subsidiary.
Ogilvy & Mather Worldwide is explicitly part, unit and division of WPP Group and owned by it.
Powell is chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, a person-to-office relation rather than subsidiary-to-parent.
Conde Nast Publications is explicitly a unit/part of and owned by Advance Publications.
Bozell Worldwide is explicitly unit/part of and owned by Bozell.
